subcommands.name: get-scaling-plan-resource-forecast-data
subcommands.description: Retrieves the forecast data for a scalable resource.

options.name: --scaling-plan-name
options.description: The name of the scaling plan

options.name: --scaling-plan-version
options.description: The version number of the scaling plan. Currently, the only valid value is 1

options.name: --service-namespace
options.description: The namespace of the AWS service. The only valid value is autoscaling

options.name: --resource-id
options.description: The ID of the resource. This string consists of a prefix (autoScalingGroup) followed by the name of a specified Auto Scaling group (my-asg).

options.name: --scalable-dimension
options.description: The scalable dimension for the resource. The only valid value is autoscaling:autoScalingGroup:DesiredCapacity

options.name: --forecast-data-type
options.description: The type of forecast data to get.    LoadForecast: The load metric forecast.     CapacityForecast: The capacity forecast.

options.name: --start-time
options.description: The inclusive start time of the time range for the forecast data to get. The date and time can be at most 56 days before the current date and time

options.name: --end-time
options.description: The exclusive end time of the time range for the forecast data to get. The maximum time duration between the start and end time is seven days.
